title: docs: clarify documentation versioning between latest and stable releases
body:
## What does this PR do?

Adds an explicit "Documentation Versions" guide in `docs/README.md` explaining the differences between `stable` (reflecting the latest released Podman version matching standard distribution packages), `latest` (tracking the active `main` branch with in-development features and unreleased CLI flags), and pinned release URLs. Also corrects a typo in the API reference section.

## Why?

Users visiting documentation links frequently get confused between features in the unreleased `main` development branch (`latest`) versus the stable installed version of Podman on their machines (`stable`).

Fixes #17233

## Testing

Verified rendered markdown formatting and link destinations.
